notes.title: Minimap and More! Update (Version 1.10.16802)
notes.notes:
[h3]Before we get into today's update - take a look at April's last big update featuring CTF-Lagoon in case you missed it![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1469060/view/4216006291770097029


[h3][u]Maps and More! Update Overview[/u][/h3]
Welcome to Update 1.10.16802 for May 9th, 2024! This update includes one of the biggest changes to the in-game UI yet - the minimap. 

Players will be able to have a glanceable as well as expandable view of teammate, enemy, and objective locations - enabling a whole new level of situational awareness.

On top of that - players will find a whole host of updates, tweaks, and fixes for their game experience. (More FOV, anyone?)

[b]Important Note: With this update we are moving to a new back-end system for item management. While we get it fully operational, you will not see your customization items. We will be migrating the items to the new system over the next 24-48 hours. After that point if you continue not to see your earned customization items, please reach out to us on Discord or info@vectorzstudios.com [/b]

[h3]UI[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Minimap:[/b] Overlays player, enemy (if detected by IFF), objective positions on the HUD. 
[list][*]Customizable features are: minimap on/off, rotation with player or static, minimap compass enable/disable. [/list][list][*]Additionally - you can set a keybind to toggle minimap or cycle map zoom.[/list][/list][list][*] [b]Full Map Display:[/b] In addition to the minimap, players also open a larger map to display a wider gamespace. 
[list][*]Needs to be set with a keybind. [/list][/list][list]
[*] [b]Radial HP / Health Bars:[/b] Health Points and the Energy Bar are now visible in the center of the HUD. They provide a quick view of your player state and energy. 
[list][*]Each can be enabled or disabled independently in the Settings menu.[/list][/list][list][*] [b]Practice Menu:[/b] Several updates to the usability and functionality of the CTRL+P menu.
[list][*]Slight visual update[/list] [list][*]Fixed various refresh issues[/list] [list][*]Fixed blurring issue[/list] [list][*]Fixed titles wrapping on multiple lines[/list] [list][*]Prevent left click/mousewheel issues[/list] [list][*]Escape key now closes the menu, but only when the mouse cursor is over the widget[/list] [list][*]Fixed duplicate Bot/Location/Drill when saving under a new name[/list] [list][*]Added buttons to load Pub Starter data, and generic Pub Starter data to edit/save[/list] [list][*]Updated Save Practice Data filename to include the mapname ( {map}-{date}.txt)[/list] [list][*]Added help tab[/list][list][*]Added buttons to spawn bots directly from the route list[/list][/list][list][*] [b]Other Updates:[/b]
[list][*]Added a basic movement video tutorial after the welcome message[/list][list][*]Added a players online counter to main menu[/list][list][*]Added a list of spectators to the scoreboard overlay[/list]
[/list][h3]Maps[/h3][list][*] [b]CTF-Nightflare:[/b]
[list][*]Disabled collision on foliage rocks[/list][list][*]Smoothed patch of rough terrain front-right of base[/list][/list][list][*] [b]CTF-Relay:[/b]
[list][*]Smoothed terrain where tower was on previous map versions[/list][list][*]Added new back spawn[/list][list][*]Lowered some of the middle rocks and radar[/list][/list][list][*] [b]CTF-Elite:[/b]
[list][*]Added cactus to help landmark back-left route[/list][list][*]Prevented collision with crane vents (fixes accidental movement while walking on rim)[/list][/list][list][*] [b]CTF-Vortex (Prototype):[/b]
[list][*]Protocype maps open using console commands and are not in map vote pool[/list][/list]
[h3]Additional Updates[/h3][list][*]Increased FOV slider maximum to 150. Players have used configs to increase their FOV, we feel that it is only appropriate for all players to have this option via Settings
[*]Adjusted rubberbanding fix to reduce desync issues [*]Players now spawn with 3 beacons instead of 1, added a UI element for beacon count[*]Nuggets dropped on death have new VFX to improve visibility and understanding [*] Improvement to crashes when joining servers [*] Reduced AFK timeout to 30 seconds from 60[/list]

Have fun and see you in-game!

notes.title: Spring Update Patch Notes (Version 1.10.0.16568)
notes.notes:
[h3]Overview[/h3]
This Playtest patch features a host of map changes and updates including a brand-new CTF-Lagoon experience, just in time for the sunny weather! Players will also experience weapon, audio, UI, and other Quality of Life updates!

[h3]Map Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New Map! CTF-Lagoon:[/b] Enjoy a bright sunny beach day and drop-in spawns!
[*] [b]CTF-Nightflare:[/b] Skybox updated, added 2 stadium lamps per base area, fixed terrain mirroring in the back rocks.
[*] [b]CTF-Twilight Grove:[/b] Fixed terrain near the left spawn bowl.
[*] [b]CTF-Minora:[/b] Removed birds based on feedback as they could sometimes be misinterpreted as incoming players for spotting purposes.
[*] [b]CTF-Ingonyama:[/b] Adjusted several spawn locations to help defending team control their base rock more easily.
[*] [b]CTF-Silvas:[/b] The hill directly in front of each base is now a valley - enabling faster travel through the middle of the map.
[*] [b]CTF-Brynhildr:[/b] Moved side spawns back so that they don't block routes.
[*] [b]CTF-Relay:[/b] Removed some spawn points that were either too weak or too strong, removed tower near the base.   
[/list]

[h3]Weapons[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Blaster:[/b] Damage increased from 35 to 39, inheritance increased from 0% to 100%. Bullet speed slowed to 10% to match Chaingun bullet speed.
[*] [b]Plasma:[/b] Added VFX trail to projectiles. Reverted to single-shot firing style.
[*] Known Weapon Issue: when other players fire the Plasma or Blaster, you incorrectly hear the sound of the Grenade Launcher.
[*] [b]Combo Grenade:[/b] Increased shootable hitbox size, added VFX to match. Reduced toss and fall speeds. Increased inheritance to 100%
[*] [b]Beacon:[/b] Increased scale from 0.5 to 1.0
[*] Increased distance needed for skillshot stars with Chaingun and Blaster.
[/list]

[h3]Audio[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated jetpack ignite sound to have slightly less bass kick, reduced "gas hiss" sound which was similar to the "out of energy" sound.
[*] Reduced volume of stadium lamp electrical buzz.
[/list]

[h3]Misc and QoL[/h3]
[list]
[*] Practice menu visuals updated in early stages of UI overhaul.
[*] Fixed toggle for damage numbers not working.
[*] Improved rubberbanding for players skiing with high ping.
[/list]

notes.title: BIG GREEN BUTTON Patch Notes - 1.10.0.16425
notes.notes:
[h3]Overview[/h3]
Here it folks, this is the big update we’ve been working towards for several months now. We will finally open up access to Midair 2 directly on Steam, allowing users to request access and join the Playtest without needing to join discord and get a key. Additionally, we will now leave Playtest servers up 24x7 instead of just on the weekends. These are two huge changes in and of themselves, but we’ve got a patch chock-full of updates, new features, and bug fixes as well. Thank you so much to all those who’ve participated in Playtest since last October; we’re excited to share this next phase of Playtest with you all!

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added floating damage numbers with toggle (visible in last patch but absent from notes)
[*] Demo fixes and functional again
[*] Patreon supporters will now get an (optional?) star next to their in-game name
[/list]

[h3]Audio[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated jetpack sfx
[*] Added 2nd layer of speed-based wind
[/list]

[h3]Map Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] All CTF & TDM maps: Consistency in post-processing settings for lens-flare (off), motion blur (on), and LUTs.
[*] Some fogs are now volumetric in levels where they weren’t before
[*] Relay, Forlorn, Hadrian, Octane, Silvas have received significant visual updates.
[*] Minor visual tweaks and a couple of minor bug fixes elsewhere.
[*] CTF-Kryosis and CTF-Raptor, among a few others, have been removed for the time being while reworks are considered.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Duplicate servers should no longer appear in server browser
[*] Sorting by ping should be fixed
[*] Framerate cap should be fixed - changing requires restarting the game.
[*] Motion blur fixed - works in first person as well as third now
[*] 
[/list]

[h3]QoL[/h3]
[list]
[*] Flag grab speed is now displayed in chat
[*] Friendly IFFs now always visible
[*] Shrunk spawn-in beam VFX; adjusted animation timing
[*] Updated all CTF loading screens and end of match screens
[*] Updated Practice Menu with latest maps and thumbnails
[*] Removed deaths from in-game scoreboard
[*] kills will soon be awarded to enemy that last shot you, if >50% dmg, when you evacuate before deat
[/list]

[h3]Known Issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bot behaviour - planning a bigger upgrade in future, but will fix the following issues soon:
[*] Issues with hit markers/hit audio
[*] Bot jetpack audio will sound buggy due to some undesirable behaviour
[*] Matchmaking has received significant simplification but is as yet non-functional, we hope to address this in an update soon.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 1.10.0.16143
notes.notes:
[h2]Overview[/h2]
This week’s patch features a bunch of new sounds, visuals, and items for your inventory. We have been inspired by the warm reception to recent weapon tweaks, and plan to continue refreshing and adding to the tools at your disposal. Additionally, CTF-Highway (fka Crater) has received significant terrain changes, visual and gameplay tweaks, and brought more in-line with smaller form CTF maps. We hope you enjoy it! Please let us know what you think of this patch in our feedback forum on discord.

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a basic beacon, default ‘c’ to place, 1 per spawn, can be used to stop or redirect.
[*] CTF flag hitbox slightly increased
[*] League flag is now a ball
[*] Ski trail visual update
[/list]
[h3]Audio[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Tempest firing sound
[*] New Grenade Launcher projectile arming sfx
[*] Added doppler effect to flag idle and skiing audio
[*] Increased range of skate and jetpack audio
[/list]
[h3]Weapons[/h3]
[list]
[*] Cleaned up Tempest projectile trail
[*] New Grenade Launcher projectile trail
[/list]
[h3]Map Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] CTF-Highway is now the new featured name for what was known as CTF-Crater
[*] Flag stands have been brought closer together, more in-line with original Crater
[*] Flag stand building edits and improvements - spiderwalk and conduits added and functional, some optimizations, tower shorter than it was
[*] Design-minded terrain edits in lots of places, but particularly around stand
[*] Rocks added in strategic spots for standoffs, spawns, and restricting some route angles
[*] Boosts on stand-to-stand bridge reduced to one, and boost impulse halved
[*] CTF-Elite now has a spaceship passing through its system. Do not be afraid, spaceship can’t hurt you.
[/list]
[h3]QoL[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added notification to let players know if playtest is offline
[*] Fixed Gold skin for Grenade Launcher and Chaingun
[*] Updated default keybindings to: 
[*] Q - Ability 
[*] E - Zoom 
[*] F - Use 
[*] X - Camera 
[*] C - Beacon 
[*] B - Spray
[/list]

[h3]More Info[/h3]
Join the Midair 2 discord to find out more: https://discord.gg/midair2

notes.title: Patch Notes - 1.10.0.16006
notes.notes:
[h2]Overview[/h2]
This patch contains the update from Unreal Engine 4.23 to Unreal Engine 4.27. The new engine version will allow the team to make more frequent updates in a more stable and responsive environment. Read more here ([url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/engine-upgrade-2-94784375]https://www.patreon.com/posts/engine-upgrade-2-94784375[/url])

[h3]Map Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] CTF - Crater: Reworked terrain based on feedback from original, added new custom flag stand/building, relight, and atmosphere
[*] Updated Practice Routes for: CTF-Brynhildr, CTF-Elite, CTF-Exhumed, CTF-Ingonyama, CTF-Minora, CTF-NightFlare, CTF-TwilightGrove[/list]

[h3]Weapons[/h3]
[list]
[*] Blaster Rework - New Shooting Mechanic. Updated since weapon preview: Damage decreased, rate of fire slowed, bullet spread reduced, accuracy reduced, added gravity.
[*] Plasma Rework - New Shooting Mechanic. Updated since weapon preview: Longer burst duration, projectile hitbox increased, projectile speed decreased, accurary increased, reduced gravity
[/list]

[h3]QOL[/h3]
[list]
[*] Santa Hats Mode Enabled
[*] Added a "Message of the day" system for servers to display a message to users
[*] Some temporary updates to menu as features are being worked on.
[/list]

[h3]More Info[/h3]
Sign up for the Closed Beta in the official Midair 2 Discord channel: [url=https://discord.gg/midair2]https://discord.gg/midair2[/url]
